statement.text: An $H$-factor in a graph $G$ is a set of vertex-disjoint copies of $H$ covering all vertices of $G$. Problem Let $c$ be a fixed positive real number and $H$ a fixed graph. Is it NP-hard to determine whether a graph $G$ on $n$ vertices and minimum degree $cn$ contains and $H$-factor?

title: Complexity of the H-factor problem.
